data centre said to 'allow more content to be locally available'

COD.note: Internet Society names two new data centres in the future tense, not stated in service or for hire.

facts.fact: Internet Society says the Kinshasa Internet Exchange (KINIX), built by ISPA-DRC in November 2012, has increased local internet traffic from a few Mbps to close to 80 Gbps over ten years.
Internet Society says ISPA-DRC launched a second IXP in Lubumbashi (LUBIX) in 2019 and a third in Goma (GOMIX), operating since 2021.

COD.note: States no figure for the share of people using the internet.
No data centre for hire in service or its owner stated.
Says nothing about startup law or funding.
